system.description: This trait is only available to biomorphs. The morph has a natural immunity to a specific drug, disease, or toxin. When afflicted with that specific chemical, poison, or pathogen, you are unaffected. Work with your GM to select an appropriate agent; this immunity may not be applied to nanodrugs or nanotoxins.

effects.description: You are immune to this drug, disease or toxin (choose one)
